_description: Auto-format Python files with black and ruff after every write or edit.
_install: Merge the 'hooks.PostToolUse' array below into your .claude/settings.json

hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"filePath\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && black --quiet "$f" && ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" || true'
